leads.title: Supreme Court of the Netherlands - 12 July 2024 ruling on same-sex marriage in Aruba
leads.documents: Legalizes same-sex marriage in Aruba; upholds Appeals Court decision barring discrimination based on sexual orientation.
leads.detail: Cited as 'On 12 July 2024, the Supreme Court of the Netherlands ruled that same-sex marriage is legal in Aruba'; No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Dutch Supreme Court (Hoge Raad) - 13 April 2007 ruling on inter-country marriage recognition
leads.documents: Requires Kingdom constituent countries to recognize each other's marriages; forced Aruba to recognize same-sex marriages registered in the Netherlands, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.
leads.detail: Cited as case brought by lesbian couple who married in Netherlands then moved to Aruba, ruled 13 April 2007; No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Aruba Criminal Code (Wetboek van Strafrecht / Kodigo Penal), enacted 2012
leads.documents: Prohibits unfair discrimination and incitement to hatred and violence including on ground of 'heterosexual or homosexual orientation'; defines discrimination and provides penalties.
leads.detail: Cited as Article 1:221 definition of discrimination, Articles 2:61 and 2:62 penalties from fines to one year imprisonment; No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Estates of Aruba - Registered Partnership Bill 2015-2016
leads.documents: Creates registered partnerships open to opposite-sex and same-sex couples; legislative history of LGBTQ relationship recognition machinery.
leads.detail: Cited as bill submitted April 2015, introduced 22 August 2016 by MP Desiree de Sousa-Croes, postponed to 8 September 2016, passed 11-5; No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Parliament of Aruba - Same-sex Marriage Bill (2022-2024)
leads.documents: Legislative attempts to legalize same-sex marriage by statute; shows parliamentary support level and rejection by tie votes.
leads.detail: Cited as introduced June 2022 by MPs Miguel Mansur, Misha Raymond, Marisol Tromp, Aquannette Gunn, tie votes in May and June 2024 leading to rejection; No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Kingdom of the Netherlands Four-Country Agreement - April 2015
leads.documents: Political agreement by representatives of all four constituent countries that same-sex couples should have equal rights throughout the Kingdom.
leads.detail: Cited as 'In April 2015, representatives of all four constituent countries agreed'; No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Fundacion Orguyo Aruba
leads.documents: LGBTQ+ rights organization that supported the court case leading to legalization of same-sex marriage; rights machinery actor.
leads.detail: Cited as 'court case leading to the legalization of same-sex marriage was supported by Fundacion Orguyo Aruba'; No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Alternative Lifestyle Federation Aruba - statement on living conditions
leads.documents: Documents social acceptance/enforcement climate: claim Aruba has always been accepting if discreet, people are out but discreetly out, nothing official.
leads.detail: Quoted as 'Aruba has always been accepting, as long as it's not in their face. People are out, but discreetly out.'; No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Oduber-Lamer case (2004-2007) - Charlene and Esther Oduber-Lamer
leads.documents: Documented incident of anti-same-sex harassment and government opposition; couple whose challenge forced recognition of same-sex marriage reported frequent harassment and rocks thrown at them.
leads.detail: Cited as court challenge between 2004 and 2007 with Aruban government vocal opposition; No URL visible in text.
